opening.argument: The presentation promotes purchasing Hashing24 mining power as an investment, stating that viewers can buy power forever and linking that purchase to daily income. It describes a 1.5-terahash contract and displays a contract record with BTC-denominated cost and income fields, while associating the service with a stated daily net-income figure. It then directs viewers to a referral link and instructs them to use a promo code, connecting audience action to the promoted service. Although the speaker acknowledges that revenue cannot remain constant and mentions maintenance costs, those qualifications do not change the promotional structure. The available evidence does not establish completed payment, actual returns, or the accuracy of the income claim.
